text: AI is changing how we think about creativity. Today, AI can produce impressive works of art, compose original music, and even write stories or poems. Some people worry this means human creativity is becoming less important. However, AI does not create in the same way we do. Human creativity comes from personal experience, emotion, and imagination. Machines follow patterns and data to generate something new, but they don't truly feel or understand what they create. So, AI is best seen as a tool that can inspire us or speed up our work. Our own ideas and emotions still make human creativity unique.
